mapper.select: SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.public_id=#{publicId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.public_id=#{publicId}
SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT event_id,refund_id,attempt_no,outcome,amount,reason,disposition FROM refund_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_request SET status=#{outcome},failure_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE refund_request SET status='PROCESSING',attempt_no=attempt_no+1,failure_reason=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED' AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE payment SET refund_status=#{target} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='PAID' AND refund_status=#{expected}
